sources.title: madlad400-3b-mt: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview madlad400-3b-mt is a multilingual machine translation model built on the T5 architecture and maintained by google. The model was trained on 1 trillion tokens covering over 450 languages using publicly available data, making it competitive with significantly larger models.
